references.text: Earlier in the same chapter it is mentioned that the Kohathites received cities by lot, which provides context for verse 10.
The clans of the Kohathites are mentioned as part of the tribe of Levi, and Aaron's descendants belonged to this group.
Levi's sons and Aaron's lineage are described here, showing Aaron's connection to the Kohathites.
The clans of the Levites, including the Kohathites, are mentioned in connection with the census.
A parallel text describing the cities given to Aaron's sons from the clan of the Kohathites.
The principle of casting lots for distributing land among the tribes of Israel.
Casting lots as a method for dividing inheritances in Israel is mentioned here.
